questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring photographers and photography history. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to photographers and photography history, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with photographers and photography history. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with photographers and photography history. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Research two photographers from different periods or movements. Compare their approaches, contexts and the social impact of their work. Show how your research has informed your own photographic practice. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 response will: name specific photographs with dates; analyse HOW and WHY photographers work, not just describe; understand social/cultural context; compare approaches thoughtfully; show CLEAR connections between researched photographers and own work; evaluate how research transformed their thinking. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
